sentences.en: The debate rages amongst cat fanciers; indoor or outdoor?

sentences.en: Then he bursts into one of his wild furies and rages at everyone and everything, seizes the letters, opens them, and reads those from the Emperor addressed to others.
sentences.vi: Sau đó, anh ta lao vào một trong những thú vui hoang dã của mình và nổi cơn thịnh nộ với tất cả mọi người và mọi thứ, chiếm lấy các bức thư, mở chúng và đọc những bức thư từ Hoàng đế gửi cho những người khác.

sentences.en: Controversy rages with lip plumpers and is the pain worth the gain?
sentences.vi: Tranh cãi nảy lửa với những người làm đẹp môi và liệu nỗi đau có đáng để đạt được?

sentences.en: Praline - The debate rages on as to whether this confection is pronounced "pray leen", or "praw leen".

sentences.en: The case battle rages on, although Pierce Marshall passed away in June, 2006.

sentences.en: In 1996, she was praised for her role in No One Would Tell with Fred Savage (The Wonder Years), where she played the girlfriend of a controlling teen boyfriend who was ultimately murdered because of his jealous rages.

sentences.en: The tiny nugget of almost unrelated truth in these foaming-at-the-mouth rages is that video games have become a very broad form of entertainment.

sentences.en: This time rages from as little as one month or can be as long as five years or more.

sentences.en: Wanting to fully possess someone and flying into jealous rages is very common with this aspect.
